author.title: The Author
author.lead: Born in Fez, Morocco, in 1946, Gérard Fauré is a French author whose autobiographical accounts revisit his Moroccan youth and the Parisian circles of the 1970s and 1980s.
body: Dealer du Tout-Paris: Le fournisseur des stars parle, written in collaboration with Ange Peltereau and published by Nouveau Monde Éditions in 2018, opened this autobiographical cycle.
Le Prince de la coke followed in 2020. L’Éducation d’un voyou, published in 2021, returned to his beginnings and Moroccan youth.
He continues this work of testimony through his books and recorded interviews.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: Gérard Fauré is responsible for the processing of personal data collected through this website. For privacy enquiries: hello@gerardfaure.fr.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: This site collects only the data you provide voluntarily: your email address if you subscribe to the newsletter, and the information entered in the contact form.

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: Messages sent through the form are used only to answer your enquiry. The information is transmitted through Resend, the site’s transactional email provider, solely for delivery. No data is sold or used for advertising.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses no advertising cookies and no third-party trackers. Audience measurement is carried out without cookies and without personally identifying data.

sections.heading: Videos
sections.body: YouTube videos load only at the moment you click to play them. Until you start a video, no data is sent to YouTube.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, or unsubscribe from the newsletter using the link in every email. For any request: hello@gerardfaure.fr.
